title: TSA Digital ID Checkpoints Grew Nearly 10x
hook: Only 20 states participate, but checkpoints jumped from 27 to 250.
closing: Digital ID is spreading fast, but travelers still need physical backup.
question: Would you use phone ID?

segments.say: TSA digital ID reached 20 states, nearly double the earlier 11. The rollout is broadening, but remains limited.
TSA digital ID checkpoints grew to 250, nearly ten times the earlier count. Access expanded much faster than state participation.
Only 20 of 50 states accept TSA digital ID. Most travelers still need physical identification.
